residual_risk: Pinned Tencent equations through a qualified BF16 MPS adapter, not stock CUDA/Magi reproduction.
Numerical route sensitivity is not articulation, successful acting, physical contact or visual quality.
Named allocation counters exclude opaque MPS resources; sampled process memory cannot certify instantaneous GPU peak.
One qualification forward time is not a speed benchmark.
The external source manifest pin and unoptimized checker invocation are roots of the independent replay chain.
next_boundary: Bounded soft per-query action-key spatial-routing dose response at fixed refined states/T0/noise, then a short visible head/glove test. Pivot to explicit pose/trajectory if articulation remains weak.
